label: copy-phase last step of short (L<=4) sequences when input is y/r/n/e/g/j
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original phase or on <DEL>), only on copy inputs that repeat an earlier token (in_first=0), at recall_idx 2-5, mostly on the last step or the one before it (to_go 0 carries 77% of mass). The strongest activations are on the final step of L=3 and L=4 sequences when the fed-back input is y, r, n, e, g or j (e.g. s r k <DEL> s [r]). In L=3, last step with an input from that set it fires with 91% precision. Firing is much rarer when the original sequence contains digits. The token set on its own gives 90% recall but only 3% precision. A long tail of weaker activations in longer sequences (L 5-9, around 35% of mass) near the end of the copy is not captured, and many L=4 last steps with these inputs do not fire, so this description is incomplete. Dev F1 0.39, mass recall 0.59.
